description.value: Marine Drive Liquor Store is a small retail bottle shop situated on the White Rock beachfront strip, described by customers as a convenient beach-front stop with a wide drink selection and notably friendly staff. The store offers online ordering for pickup and has built a local following for personalized service, including sourcing special-occasion bottles on short notice.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business name, address (15547 Marine Dr, White Rock, BC V4B 1C9), and phone (6043851483) all match OSM tags. The site describes a retail liquor store with online ordering and is characterized as a 'beach front liquor store.' No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cycling amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM website URL (https://176838.com/payal) is a third-party website-builder domain; the path 'payal' appears unrelated to the business name and may not be a stable or permanent URL.
Website page header reads 'Welcome to our Restaurant' in the navigation, which conflicts with the business being a liquor store — likely a template artifact from the website builder.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A beachfront liquor store on a popular cycling corridor could serve touring cyclists, but the listing meets none of the WWC required criteria (no confirmed bike parking, water, or washrooms), making its directory value minimal without further on-site verification.
enrichment_extras.notes: Marine Drive in White Rock is a known cycling route; proximity to the beach promenade may make this a useful informal supply stop for cyclists, but amenity evidence is absent.

Packed lunches.detail: Liquor store only; no food preparation or lunch service indicated
